about: Scenes for the animated video of From Roadmaps to Rituals. Each scene starts at a phrase in the narration ("at"); keys ending in At name phrases that trigger a move inside the scene. Chapter cards are added by render.mjs.

scenes.text: PRDs, status updates, pulling data for reviews, the same questions in different formats.

scenes.text: Which recurring ritual in my product practice can an AI agent support, or partly own?
